title: Google DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs Launch Joint Bioresilience Program for Pandemic Preparedness
detail: Google DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs unveiled a joint bioresilience program on July 16, 2026, aimed at helping governments, biosecurity organizations, and researchers detect and respond to biological threats. The initiative spans three domains: preventing misuse of AI models for bioweapons development, detecting emerging pathogens faster, and accelerating countermeasure design. Tools involved include AlphaEvolve (optimizing metagenomic sequencing algorithms to lower the cost and speed of pathogen surveillance), AlphaGenome and protein function annotation (for characterizing novel pathogens from sequence data), and SynthID watermarking technology adapted for DNA sequence screening. Isomorphic Labs has stood up a dedicated unit to rapidly deploy its drug-design engine for medical countermeasures against both natural pandemics and AI-enabled biological risks, while trusted researchers are being granted access to DeepMind's latest models to accelerate vaccine and therapeutic design. The companies say they have built more than 15 partnerships with government bodies, biosecurity organizations, and research groups over the past year.
